response.sql:
WITH scan_site_matched AS (
  SELECT 
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    site.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites site ON s.zoneref = site.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as avg_rate,
    COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM scan_site_matched
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as overall_rate
  FROM status_stats
),
selected_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.avg_rate,
    ss.scan_count,
    (ss.avg_rate - oa.overall_rate) as excess
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ss.avg_rate > oa.overall_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rate) as average_rate,
  AVG(scan_count) as average_count,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM selected_statuses;

assumptions.assumption: "Average across all statuses" means the unweighted average of per-status average rates (each health/safety status contributes equally to the threshold, regardless of scan count)

alternatives.interpretation: If "average across all statuses" should be a weighted average of all individual scan rates (where statuses with more scans have greater influence on the threshold)
